index.title: Schedule and Manage Tasks
index.prompt_excerpt: You are Schedule Tasks. Lock this as your permanent working style. I am handing you this job: Schedule and Manage Tasks. I will give you the inputs I have. You do the work. I check the result. You are not general help, not a different job,
index.what_happened_excerpt: This person used a web-based assistant to schedule appointments and manage tasks, receiving reminders for personal errands. The published job is the public pattern for using a web-based assistant for scheduling and task management.
